card.name: Small words before disease or food terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or closing brackets (of, and, active, a closing parenthesis) in dosing text, right before a noun like a condition, patient group or food such as applesauce.

modes.label: Of before a noun
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'treatment' or a measured amount, just before a condition or food.
modes.example: Place one tablespoonful<< of>> applesauce into a clean container.

modes.label: Qualifier before a disease
modes.description: Words like 'active' or a closing bracket that sit between a severity or duration qualifier and the disease or symptom.
modes.example: with moderately to severely<< active>> UC.

modes.label: And between patient groups
modes.description: The word 'and' joining adults to pediatric patients.
modes.example: adults<< and>> pediatric patients weighing at least 25

card.writes: It seems to promote words like adult and single, so the next word is often a patient group or a single-unit term.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in dosing text just before the patient group, disease or food comes up.
